title: Add Pollinations NPC for Roblox to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]

gist.summary: Added Pollinations NPC for Roblox to the app catalog and README. Its Luau module gives an NPC a persona and a separate conversation with each player using Pollinations text models, with replies shown as chat bubbles. The API key stays in Roblox's secrets store. The example NPC is Grix the blacksmith.

image.prompt: In a cozy Roblox-style pixel village, a blocky blacksmith NPC named Grix chats with a player through simple speech bubbles beside a forge and lime green (#ecf874) code-plants; Polli watches warmly in a tiny blacksmith apron. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image; strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
